notes: NEW: Smart Outfit Color Harmonizer adds six optional advanced color categories—Leather & Straps, Lace & Mesh, Ribbons & Bows, Gems & Crystals, Stockings & Socks, and Shoes & Boots. Each category can inherit from Primary, Accent, or Jewelry / Metal, or use its own custom color. The Advanced Categories panel remembers your choices per account. The existing three colors, Swap, Undo, locked-item protection, and all plushie, chat and Pet Bed features remain. Separate detail recoloring requires suitable colorable layers in the BC asset.

items: Six customizable harmonizer categories for leather/straps, lace/mesh, ribbons/bows, gems/crystals, stockings/socks and shoes/boots.
Per-category inheritance source (Primary / Accent / Jewelry & Metal), optional independent color picker and saved settings per account.
Expanded Advanced Categories panel inside BC Appearance and Essentials Wardrobe harmonizer dialogs.
Metadata-aware color-zone mapping: different recolorable layers of the same garment can receive different category colors.
Primary, Accent and Jewelry / Metal core colors, Swap Primary / Accent and Undo Last.
Appearance safety: unchanged restraints, body colors, locked equipment and other characters.
All existing plushies, emoticons, Color Studio, wardrobe tools, mobile features and Pet Bed compatibility.
Embedded artwork details cannot be recolored independently if BC does not provide separate colorable layers.
Automated category detection uses recognizable clothing groups and asset names; not every third-party asset exposes enough metadata.
